title: 第11章 一步一个坑魔九哭了第12章 这妞儿真辣
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
那是一位青年。
身材高大，穿黑袍，冒黑气，横眉立目，又帅又有范儿。
就差脸上写着我是大反派。
他早已在此埋伏许久。
就等着所有人进入落日山平台，他好启动大阵，将所有人一网打尽。
“魔族！”
落仙宗大殿之上。
云阳子呼吸间消失在原地。
其余五位峰主立刻收起玩笑。
就是一直没有声音的无道都睁开双眼，望向古铜宝镜。
落日山平台。
魔族阵法之中。
李俊等人在看到那突然出现的家伙后，一眼便认出对方是魔族。
“怎么回事！魔族怎么会出现在这里，东域不是有世界之墙阻拦，还有黄金大域的黄金军团与之对战，魔族根本不可能踏足东域。”
“没错，魔族窥探东域已久，但需要通过黄金大域的黄金古道才能进入东域，黄金古道有黄金军团守护，传言更有大乘期修士镇守，魔族怎么可能进入东域腹地。”
“难道黄金大域被魔族攻破，魔族已入侵整个东域。”
此话出口。
众人一阵骚乱。
若真那样，怕是整个人族都要承受灭顶之灾。
“大家稍安勿躁，听我说。”

李俊知道此刻他必须站出来。
“虽不知道魔族为何出现，但你们要相信落仙宗的仙师们，相信他们已发现异常，正在赶来的路上，你我只要拖住，肯定会得救。”
李俊的威望颇高。
说出此话后，算是稳住军心。
“靠！还好没进去。”
踏足大陆，正准备登临落日山平台的郑拓拍拍胸脯，一副怕怕模样。
“魔族都出来了，落仙宗这考核有点东西，这是让大家提前感受魔族危机的考核手段吗？”
谨慎起见，郑拓转身就要离开。
“站住！”
那魔族十分强大。
最少三阶魔修。
其已感受到郑拓的存在。
郑拓被吓的一拘灵！
想也没想，瞬间激活大腿上的两张追风灵符。
同时。
猛然一跺脚。
content_en:
That was a young man.
He is tall, wearing a black robe, emitting a dark aura, and has a cross-browed eyebrow. He is handsome and stylish.
It just says on my face that I am the villain.
He has been lying in wait here for a long time.
He was just waiting for everyone to enter the Sunset Mountain Platform so that he could activate the formation and catch everyone in one fell swoop.
"Demon!"
Falling on top of the Immortal Sect's main hall.
Yunyangzi disappeared in one breath.
The other five peak masters immediately stopped joking.
Even Wudao, who had been silent all this time, opened his eyes and looked at the bronze mirror.
Sunset Mountain Platform.
In the demon formation.
After Li Jun and others saw the guy who suddenly appeared, they recognized him as a demon at a glance.
"What's going on! Why did the demons appear here? The Eastern Region is not blocked by the Wall of the World, and there is also the Golden Army of the Golden Region fighting against it. It is impossible for the Demons to set foot in the Eastern Region."
"Yes, the Demons have been spying on the Eastern Territory for a long time, but they need to pass through the Golden Ancient Road in the Golden Territory to enter the Eastern Territory. The Golden Ancient Road is guarded by the Golden Army, and it is rumored that it is guarded by Mahayana monks. How can the Demons enter the hinterland of the Eastern Territory."
"Could it be that the Golden Territory was conquered by the demons, and the demons have invaded the entire eastern region?"
The words came out.
There was a commotion among the people.
If that happens, I'm afraid the entire human race will suffer a disaster.
"Everyone, please be patient and listen to me."
Li Jun knew that he had to stand up at this moment.
"Although I don't know why the demons appeared, you have to believe in the immortal masters of Luo Xian Sect. I believe that they have discovered the abnormality and are on their way. As long as you and I hold them back, we will definitely be saved."
Li Jun's prestige is quite high.
After saying this, he stabilized the morale of the army.
"Damn! Fortunately, I didn't go in."
After setting foot on the mainland, Zheng Tuo, who was about to board the sunset mountain platform, patted his chest and looked scared.
"The demons have come out. There is something in the Luo Xian Sect's assessment. Is this an assessment method to let everyone feel the crisis of the demons in advance?"
To be cautious, Zheng Tuo turned around and left.
"Stop!"
That demon is very powerful.
At least third level magic cultivator.
He has felt Zheng Tuo's presence.
Zheng Tuo was so frightened!
Without thinking, he instantly activated the two wind-chasing talismans on his thighs.
at the same time.
Stomping his feet suddenly.
